factchecks.claim: Verity County ranks 43rd in the state for broadband access.
factchecks.ruling:
The number is real and the ranking is meaningless.

It counts advertised speed, not delivered speed.
evidence: The state table the figure comes from measures advertised tiers.
Two of the three providers listed do not serve the county line.

factchecks.claim: The 2003 substation fire was caused by lightning.

corrections.text: We have withdrawn a story about a county contract. It described a document we did not have.
